summary: Ramesh Deshpande lets Shop 2 in Laxmi Complex, Karve Road, Pune to Chai Kona Foods for use as a tea shop. The lease runs for three years from 1 December 2026 and renews by itself for three more years at a time unless Chai Kona gives written notice at least six months before a term ends. Leaving before the end of a term costs an exit fee of six months' rent. Rent is Rs. 65,000 a month plus GST, due by the fifth of each month, and it goes up by 15% every year. Chai Kona pays an interest-free deposit of six months' rent before moving in. Anil Joshi, its managing director, personally guarantees the rent and every other obligation. Chai Kona covers the landlord against all claims, losses and costs from its use of the shop. Indian law applies, and only the courts at Pune can hear disputes.
